source.code:
/-- The distance function (given an ambient metric space on `α`), which returns
  a nonnegative real number `dist x y` given `x y : α`. -/
@[ext]
class Dist (α : Type*) where
  /-- Distance between two points -/
  dist : α → α → ℝ
